vehicle.oil_service_due_days.meaning: signed time remaining until oil service

vehicle.oil_service_due_km.meaning: signed distance remaining until oil service

audiconnect.evidence_note: Audi Connect Q8 target runtime shows positive remaining maintenance countdowns.

cupra_eu_data_act.evidence_note: EU Data Act portal semantics: negative=remaining, positive=overdue; target Q8 shows the inverse sign versus Audi Connect.

mbapi2020.evidence_note: MBAPI exposes serviceintervaldays/serviceintervaldistance, but signed countdown semantics are not documented sufficiently; fail closed until proven.

coverage_policy.rule: Every integration adapter that maps a maintenance countdown input must declare source_conventions entry; unknown convention fails closed.
